name: saibaba-motors
description: साईबाबा मोटर्स — Used Cars & Bikes Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && npx esbuild server/serverless.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=netlify/functions/api.js && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});}"
